body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Autonomous Navigation Simulator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Photorealistic rendering with PBR materials and lighting). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Photorealistic rendering with PBR materials and lighting and LiDAR, camera, radar, IMU, GPS sensor models with noise. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) toolkit) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
